 PREVIEW: Over 30,000 expected for 'Caps final regular season home match against Seattle, presented by Chevrolet | Watch on Apple TV
 Copy URL 
 Share on Facebook 
 Share on X 
 HOW TO WATCH:   Watch on Apple TV 
 LISTEN:   730 CKNW ,  Connect FM 91.5 
 TICKETS:  Limited tickets available  HERE 
 VANCOUVER, BC – A chance at history.
 Vancouver Whitecaps FC (MLS 17W-8L-7D, 58 points) will look to clinch a first-ever first-place finish in the Western Conference this Sunday, November 1 as they host Cascadia rivals Seattle Sounders FC (MLS 11W-11L-10D, 43 points) in front of an expected crowd of over 30,000 at BC Place.
Round 1 Home Game 1 (November 22) on sale now! 
 Single-match tickets for Round One Home Game One are available for pre-purchase, subject to availability. For more information on the terms and conditions applicable to pre-purchased tickets for potential home playoff matches, click  here .
 Buy Tickets 
 The 'Caps will also have the chance to become the first team to win every match during the regular season against their fellow Cascadia rivals in Seattle and Portland, and only the fourth team in MLS history with back-to-back 60+ point seasons.
 A key reminder for fans,  kickoff is set for 1:30 p.m. PCT , following the new time zone operating in British Columbia.
 Tickets to the match are still available at  whitecapsfc.com/tickets , with the upper bowl open. The match is presented by Chevrolet, with a scarf and rally towel giveaway happening pre-match at the Fan Zone on Terry Fox Plaza and section 209 on the concourse.
 Vancouver Whitecaps FC vs. Seattle Sounders FC 
 Sunday, November 1, 2026 – 1:30 p.m. PCT
 BC Place – Vancouver, BC
 SPECTATOR INFORMATION: Fan Appreciation, before playoffs begin, presented by Chevrolet 
 BROADCAST 
 ONLINE/TV: Watch on Apple TV
 Apple TV Talent (English): Blake Price (play-by-play), Paul Dolan (anaylst)
 Apple TV Talent (Spanish): Nacho Garcia (play-by-play, analyst)
 RADIO:  Listen on 730 CKNW (English) / Connect FM 91.5 HD2 (Punjabi)
 730 CKNW Talent (English):  Asa Rehman (play-by-play), Colin Miller (analyst)
 Connect FM 91.5 HD2 Talent (Punjabi):  Jagraj Lalli (play-by-play), Pervez Sandhu (play-by-play), Jarmanjit Singh (analyst)
 MATCHUP HISTORY: The 'Caps and Seattle are tied together as far back as possible for both clubs. As part of North American Soccer League’s Western Division, the two expansion franchises’ inaugural season was 1974. Sunday's match will mark the 160th meeting between the two sides in official competition, with the ‘Caps all-time record against Seattle sitting at 55W-76L-28D.

 WEEKLY STORYLINES 
 GOOD TO BE HOME: After five consecutive road matches, Vancouver Whitecaps FC returned to BC Place in emphatic fashion by claiming a resounding 4-1 victory over San Diego FC on Wednesday. It was a night full of milestones, as Aleksa Cvetković scored his first goal for the 'Caps, while Brian White netted his 100th MLS goal to become only the 17th player in league history to join the century club. In addition, Bruno Caicedo's insurance marker helped the 'Caps set a record for most goals scored in an MLS regular season with 67. The victory also tied the club's record for most home wins in an MLS regular season with 10 and marked the 32nd time Vancouver has scored three or more goals in Jesper Sørensen's 96 games at the helm.
 KINGS OF CASCADIA: On Sunday, Vancouver turns their attention to a rivalry showdown against Seattle Sounders FC. Having already secured a record ninth Cascadia Cup, the 'Caps can make even more history by becoming the first team to win every Cascadia match in a single regular season. Vancouver swept the season series against Portland Timbers, winning 4-1 at Providence Park and 3-2 at BC Place, before earning a 2-0 victory at Seattle in August, with Rayan Elloumi and Thomas Müller finding the net. With the upper bowl open, more than 30,000 fans are expected at BC Place for Sunday's regular season home finale.
 THE SØRENSEN EFFECT: Since taking the reins in January 2025, head coach Jesper Sørensen has guided the 'Caps to become one of the league's most successful teams. Vancouver boasts the second-best regular season record over nearly two years with a combined mark of 35W-15L-16D, trailing only Nashville SC at 37W-15L-14D. Over that span, the 'Caps lead MLS in goal difference with +62, have conceded the second fewest goals allowing just 71, while also ranking second in goals scored with 133. Sørensen's 121 regular season points rank second among head coaches in their first two MLS seasons, just three points shy of Gerardo 'Tata' Martino's league record of 124 with Atlanta United FC in 2017-18.

 COLIN MILLER'S KEYS TO THE MATCH 
 Start with energy 
Seattle are fighting for their playoff lives and have good players.
We need to start like we did on Wednesday with the same intensity to keep them down.
 Playoff rhythm 
It's time to get into a rhythm before the playoffs begin.
Treat every game like a playoff game from now on.
 Competition for places 
Make Jesper's life more difficult by playing well.
All our pieces need to add to the competition for playing time.
 Catch Asa Rehman and Colin Miller on the  730 CKNW radio call this Wednesday, with the pre-match show kicking off at 1 p.m. PCT.
